about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: Adaptable, disciplined, and process-driven professional with a background in Navy operations, IT infrastructure, and international team collaboration.
about.paragraph2: My foundation was built during three years in the Brazilian Navy as an IT and Network Support Technician at the Aratu Naval Base, later expanded through international technology work with global teams.
